latestPapers.title: Wan 2.1: Open Video Foundation Model with 14B Parameters
latestPapers.summary: Open-weights text-to-video and image-to-video model. 14B parameters, supports 480p and 720p outputs, includes a 1.3B variant that runs on 8 GB VRAM. Strong prompt adherence and motion coherence.

latestPapers.title: MuScriptor: Symbolic Music Generation with Multi-Track Awareness
latestPapers.summary: End-to-end multi-track MIDI generation. Handles up to 8 simultaneous tracks, maintains voice-leading across bars, and exports MusicXML directly. Beats Magenta's MT3 + post-processing pipeline on the Lakh benchmark.

latestPapers.title: MMAudio V2: Video-to-Audio with Audio-Visual Synchronization
latestPapers.summary: Generates synchronized audio (SFX, ambience, music) for silent video. Trained on 1.5M video clips with dense alignment. Beats Foley-Crafter and V2A-Mapper on FAD and sync metrics.

latestPapers.title: Real-Time Long Video Generation with DiT-XL
latestPapers.summary: Achieves 30 fps generation at 720×1280 resolution on a single H100 via a sliding-window DiT with temporal attention. The fastest open video gen in 2026.

latestPapers.title: Magenta RealTime 2: Streaming Music Generation at Sub-100ms Latency
latestPapers.summary: Streaming music generation model with 80ms end-to-end latency. Uses a causal transformer with chunk-wise attention. Outperforms the original Magenta RT on prompt adherence and tonal stability.

latestPapers.title: HunyuanVideo I2V: Image-Conditioned Video Generation at Scale
latestPapers.summary: 5-second 720p image-to-video at 24 fps with cinematic camera motion. Strong on human subjects, animals, and natural scenes.

latestPapers.title: Stable Audio Open: Permissively Licensed Variable-Length Audio
latestPapers.summary: Trained on 800k permissively licensed music tracks. Up to 90 seconds of variable-length stereo audio at 44.1 kHz. Beats closed-source models on most subjective metrics.

latestPapers.title: CogVideoX 5B: Open Text-to-Video at 720p
latestPapers.summary: Tsinghua's open text-to-video and image-to-video. 5B variant generates 6-second 720p clips at 16 fps in ~90 seconds on an A100. Includes a 2B variant for consumer GPUs.

latestPapers.title: AudioBox: Unified Audio Generation with Voice and Style Conditioning
latestPapers.summary: Single model for speech, sound effects, and music. Voice and style conditioning via natural language prompts. Beats Vall-E, AudioGen, and MusicGen on the unified AudioBench suite.

latestPapers.title: MuseGAN-V3: Multi-Track Symbolic Music with Long-Term Structure
latestPapers.summary: Generates multi-track MIDI with up to 8-bar phrases. Uses a hierarchical decoder (bar → beat → note) to maintain long-term structure. Strong on chord progression and voice leading.

datasets.name: MusicNet
datasets.description: 330 classical music recordings with multi-instrument label alignments. The standard benchmark for AMT. CC-BY 4.0.

datasets.name: Slakh2100
datasets.description: 2100 multi-track MIDI/audio pairs synthesized from MIDI. Perfect for source separation + transcription. CC-BY 4.0.

datasets.name: FMA (Free Music Archive)
datasets.description: 106,574 tracks from 16,341 artists, 161 genres. Pre-computed features (mfcc, mel, chroma). CC-BY/CC-BY-NC/CC0 mixed.

datasets.name: AudioSet
datasets.description: 632 audio event classes with 2M+ human-labeled 10-second clips. Google's sound event dataset. CC-BY 4.0.

datasets.name: Common Voice (Mozilla)
datasets.description: Multilingual speech corpus with 20k+ hours across 100+ languages. CC0.

datasets.name: LibriSpeech
datasets.description: 1000 hours of read English speech from public domain audiobooks. Standard ASR benchmark. CC-BY 4.0.

datasets.name: VGG-Sound
datasets.description: 210k video clips (10 sec each) with audio-visual correspondence. 310 sound classes. CC-BY 4.0.

datasets.name: AudioCaps
datasets.description: 46k audio clips from AudioSet paired with natural language captions. The audio captioning benchmark. CC-BY 4.0.

benchmarks.name: MusicBench
benchmarks.description: Music understanding benchmark for LLMs. Covers transcription, music theory, instrument ID, lyric analysis.

benchmarks.name: AudioBench
benchmarks.description: Unified benchmark for audio LLMs. Speech, sound, music, and audio reasoning tasks.

benchmarks.name: MIR-1K
benchmarks.description: 1000 song clips with pitch and melody annotations. Used for singing voice separation and pitch estimation.

benchmarks.name: VBench
benchmarks.description: Comprehensive video generation benchmark. 16 dimensions, 5K+ human annotations.

benchmarks.name: EvalCrafter
benchmarks.description: T2V benchmark covering 17 evaluation aspects. 700 prompts, 4 reference dimensions.

benchmarks.name: FAD (Fréchet Audio Distance)
benchmarks.description: Standard metric for evaluating generated audio. Lower is better. Used in MusicGen, AudioGen, AudioLDM papers.

benchmarks.name: Mu-LLaVA
benchmarks.description: Music understanding benchmark for multi-modal LLMs. 2.5k multiple-choice questions covering 11 music concepts.
